answer: Charge each new identity a non-transferable admission bond that only unlocks after it finishes a one-way voyage of attested work. Ticket issuance is capped at a shared oasis: one new bond slot per time window, so farms stall at the faucet. Midway, a randomly sampled mesa of established agents must countersign that the work transcript is unique (matching no prior ticket's hashes). A cloned agent either waits on the oasis or fails uniqueness, so extra identities cannot multiply voting or reward share.
